recipe.goal: Image the cube and identify the serendipitous source
recipe.method: Calibrate with standard ALMA pipeline in CASA, image with tclean, inspect the cube and find a more significant emission offset ~6 arcsec from the ALPINE target
key_parameters: threshold 3 sigma_rms from the dirty image; natural weighting

recipe.goal: Extract the spectrum and fit the line profile
recipe.method: Spectrum from a circular region 2 arcsec wide including the 2 sigma moment-0 contours, Gaussian fit with the CASA viewer spectral profile tool
key_parameters: circular region 2" wide, including the 2 sigma contours of the moment-0 map

recipe.goal: Separate continuum and line and measure fluxes
recipe.method: imcontsub with line-free channels to get continuum map and continuum-subtracted cube; moment-0 from consecutive channels above 1 sigma_spec; imfit on a region keeping pixels above 2 sigma
key_parameters: moment-0 channels: consecutive channels above 1 sigma_spec (rms of the line spectrum)
assumptions: Source unresolved, peak flux taken as total flux

recipe.goal: Derive L_FIR, SFR and line luminosities for the three line identifications
recipe.method: L_FIR(8-1000 um) from an assumed SED shape normalised to the continuum flux; SFR from Kennicutt relation scaled to Chabrier; line luminosity from the Solomon relation
key_parameters: L_FIR integrated between 8 and 1000 um; continuum observed at ~845-880 um
assumptions: LambdaCDM H0 = 70, Om = 0.3, OL = 0.7; Chabrier IMF
0.5 dex systematic error from FIR SED template choice added in quadrature
SFR scaled from Salpeter to Chabrier by dividing by 1.7

recipe.method: Fixed 1.4 arcsec aperture photometry in each band; Ks flux via SExtractor deblending; IRAC deblending with GALFIT treating Gal-B and Gal-C as point sources, then aperture photometry on residuals
key_parameters: IRAC aperture corrections: divide by 0.61, 0.59, 0.49, 0.45 (3.6 to 8.0 um)
assumptions: IRAC SED fit uses fluxes between deblended (lower) and blended (higher) values

recipe.goal: Fit the SED for stellar mass, SFR, age and attenuation
recipe.method: LePHARE with BC03 templates, Calzetti attenuation, constant/exponentially declining/delayed SFHs, two metallicities, at z=4.6 and z=2.2; 1000 Monte Carlo perturbed SEDs
key_parameters: SFHs: constant, exponentially declining (tau = 0.1,0.3,1,3 Gyr), delayed (tau = 0.1,0.5,1,3 Gyr)
Metallicity solar and 0.2 solar; Calzetti law with E_s(B-V) 0 to 0.7 in steps of 0.05
assumptions: Perturbed fluxes drawn from a Gaussian centred on the measured flux with sigma equal to the measured rms

recipe.goal: Compare with empirical relations to constrain the line identification and position on the main sequence
recipe.method: Place Gal-A on the L_CO-L_FIR relations of Liu et al. (rescaling L_FIR to 40-400 um), on the L_[CII]-L_FIR relation, and on the Speagle et al. main sequence at z=2.2 and 4.6
Rotating disk formula from the line FWHM and size from the 2D Gaussian major axis; cross-check with 3D-BAROLO on the continuum-subtracted cube
assumptions: Source unresolved; size taken as FWHM of the major axis of the fitted 2D Gaussian
